sentence: This project builds a growth plate organoid to study how stem cells form a mature growth plate in bones.
This project studies whether host genetics or environment shape the microbes living on whiptail lizards.
This project studies how cobalt catalysts add nitrogen, oxygen, sulfur and phosphorus groups to olefins, to find out how the reaction works.
This project builds circuits that make communication waveforms carrying hardware-dependent fingerprints as embedded security features.
This project studies how flexible, unstructured parts of proteins help proteins find and bind their targets in living fission yeast cells.
This project builds statistical methods that find adaptive mutations by looking for the same changes across the microbiomes of many hosts.
This project builds infrared vision systems that work like the biological retina, sensing and processing images in one sensor element.
This project applies deep learning to model biological and physical systems that change over time, such as infectious disease spread.
This project applies nanotechnology to specific biomedical questions through research that joins engineering and biomedicine.
This project studies how ticks, their hosts, microbes and the environment interact, using genomics and statistical models.
This project builds a group of teachers who bring chip industry content into physical science classrooms.
This project makes transition metal coordination complexes that use circularly polarized light to achieve spin polarization, for use as qubits.
This project supports a conference where researchers present advances in cybersecurity, including applied cryptography and privacy.
This project uses artificial intelligence to find and predict green gentrification that follows urban sustainability initiatives in city neighborhoods.
